user.title: Ready By
user.description: Choose the heater to schedule and the temperatures it should learn from. Temperatures are assumed to be in °C.

data_description.water_sensor: Leave empty to use the heater's own current temperature.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Its hourly forecast is used for the outside temperature while heating.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional. When set, the heater counts as heating while this reads above the power threshold, instead of using the climate entity. More accurate for heat pumps that don't report hvac_action.

abort.already_configured: This heater is already set up.

data_description.water_sensor: Leave empty to use the heater's own current temperature.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Its hourly forecast is used for the outside temperature while heating.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional. When set, the heater counts as heating while this reads above the power threshold, instead of using the climate entity. More accurate for heat pumps that don't report hvac_action.
data_description.power_threshold: Power above which the heater counts as heating.
data_description.buffer_minutes: Aim to reach the target this long before the ready-by time.
data_description.seed_rate: Used until at least 3 heating sessions have been learned.
data_description.archive_mb: Ready By records its inputs once a minute so it can relearn from up to a year or more. A year takes about 5–10 MB; the oldest months are removed above this limit.
data_description.import_history: Use the recorder's history too, for the time before the input archive starts.

init.description: Changing the heater, the water, outside or power sensor, or the power threshold discards learned sessions and relearns them from recorder history.

error.already_configured: Another Ready By entry already uses this heater.

entry_not_loaded.message: That Ready By entry isn't loaded.

set_ready_by.name: Set one-off ready-by
set_ready_by.description: Sets a one-off time the water should be hot by, and turns the one-off schedule on. It turns itself off after the run.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Ready By entry to schedule.

ready_by.name: Ready by
ready_by.description: When the target should be reached.

target.name: Target
target.description: One-off target temperature. Leave empty to keep the current one.

set_daily.name: Set daily ready-by
set_daily.description: Sets the daily ready-by time or target, turns the daily schedule on or off, or sets whether it turns the heater off at the ready-by time.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Ready By entry to schedule.

time.name: Time
time.description: When the water should be hot each day. Setting it turns the daily schedule on unless enabled is false.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the daily schedule on or off.

off_at_ready_by.name: Turn off at ready-by
off_at_ready_by.description: Turn the heater off at the daily ready-by time instead of keeping it on for the hold period, for example when a cheap electricity rate ends then.

end_session.name: End session
end_session.description: Turns the heater off now, ending any run in progress before its scheduled end. A one-off schedule turns off; the daily schedule moves to its next day.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Ready By entry whose session to end.

export_sessions.name: Export sessions
export_sessions.description: Returns every learned heating session and cooling sample, in the format Import sessions takes, for backups.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Ready By entry to export.

import_sessions.name: Import sessions
import_sessions.description: Adds past heating sessions and cooling samples to the model, for example from scripts/influx_backfill.py.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Ready By entry to import into.

sessions.name: Sessions
sessions.description: List of heating sessions (start, end, water_start, water_end, outside_avg).

cooling.name: Cooling samples
cooling.description: List of idle periods in the same format.

reset_model.name: Reset model
reset_model.description: Forgets every learned session and cooling sample, then relearns from the input archive and, for the time before it, the recorder.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Ready By entry to reset.
